title: Israel Diaz Named EVP, Chief Creative Officer of Young & Rubicam Toronto
abstract: 2011-02-10 press release naming Diaz EVP/CCO of Y&R Toronto. States his prior roles: Managing Partner and Executive Creative Director at David&Goliath (helped establish its Toronto office; Kia Motors Canada); five years as Managing Partner/SVP/Creative Director at Leo Burnett Toronto (Visa, Kellogg's, BlackBerry, Coca-Cola, Procter & Gamble); Associate Creative Director at Lowe Roche; Senior Art Director at Cossette Communications (McDonald's, General Mills, Nike, Mercedes-Benz). Cites over 16 years of industry experience as of 2011, a #2 Top Creative Director in Canada ranking (Strategy Magazine, 2010), and a #4 global Creative Director ranking (Big Won Report, 2009).
